annotations.title: Resolve Reddit targeting: communities, keywords, geos, interests, devices, carriers, languages

description: Look up the exact values Reddit ad-group targeting expects, so none of them has to be guessed. kind:"communities" searches subreddits by keyword and returns each one’s NAME plus its subscriber count — targeting wants the bare name ("running"), NOT the t5_ id and NOT "r/running". kind:"community_suggestions" asks Reddit which communities fit some topics (query, comma-separated) and/or a websiteUrl — the best way to widen reach. kind:"keywords" turns seed terms (keywords, or query comma-separated) into Reddit’s keyword suggestions WITH MONTHLY VIEWS, sorted biggest first — also a quick read on what Reddit is talking about. kind:"keyword_check" asks Reddit whether keywords are targetable under its brand-safety rules; leave the unsafe ones out of targeting.keywords. kind:"geolocations" lists targetable places (pass country like US, or a city search) — targeting accepts a country code or one of the returned ids. kind:"interests" lists Reddit’s interest taxonomy — targeting wants the id ("pets_v3"). kind:"devices" / "carriers" / "languages" list what targeting.devices / carriers (e.g. VERIZON_US) / languages (e.g. EN) take; "third_party_audiences" lists partner data segments with their size and CPM data cost. Read-only, free. Use this before create_reddit_ads_ad_group rather than inventing a value.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

keywords.description: keywords / keyword_check: the terms (up to 1,000, each ≤100 characters)

postalCode.description: postal code to narrow a geolocations search

query.description: keyword — required for communities; topics for community_suggestions; seeds for keywords; filters interests / devices / carriers / languages; searches cities for geolocations

websiteUrl.description: community_suggestions: suggest communities related to this site
